messages.subject: [FLR-list] Problems with FLR packages with OS X El Capitan
messages.subject_clean: [FLR-list] Problems with FLR packages with OS X El Capitan
messages.body_plain:
Dear Sir,
I have problems installing some FLR packages (FLXSA, FLAssess, FLBRP) on my Macbook Pro (OS X El Capitan). 
My version of R is R 3.3.1 GUI 1.68 Mavericks build (7238) and of RStudio is 0.99.879.
How can I install all the FLR packages, in a correct way?

Thank you so much in advance.

Best regards,
Ilaria Costantini

messages.subject: [FLR-list] Problems with FLR packages with OS X El Capitan
messages.subject_clean: [FLR-list] Problems with FLR packages with OS X El Capitan
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

At this point we do not have packages compiled for OSX. Some of them, 
like FLCore, can be compiled in your own machine by installing the 
necessary tools, as shown in

http://cran.us.r-project.org/bin/macosx/RMacOSX-FAQ.html#How-to-install-packages

Packages based on Cpp, like FLXSA and FLash, are unlikely to work on OSX 
in their present form. For the later a new version is being developed 
that will work on OSX, but FLXSA will not be updated in any way, as it 
is an old method that should probably be abandoned. You could instead 
look at FLa4a https://github.com/flr/FLa4a

So if you need any package with Cpp code you will need to run them on 
Linux or Windows, maybe using a virtual machine.

Best,


Iago
